name: Two-finger guitar arps
desc: Ghanaian highlife rhythm guitar in Db major: the two-finger broken-third arpeggio style of E.T. Mensah dance bands, rolling eighths over a I-IV-V-IV turnaround on a bright wavetable acoustic guitar. Sunny, chiming, endlessly circular.

code.sparse: note("<[db3 f3 ab3 f3] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3] [ab3 c4 eb4 c4] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_aguitar").attack(.005).decay(.3).sustain(.15).release(.1).hpf(350).lpf(3500).gain(${gain}*.85).room(.25).pan(.55).orbit(4).play()
code.full: note("<[db3 f3 ab3 f3 db4 ab3 f3 ab3] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3 gb4 db4 bb3 db4] [ab3 c4 eb4 c4 ab4 eb4 c4 eb4] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3 gb4 db4 bb3 db4]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_aguitar").attack(.004).decay(.26).sustain(.12).release(.08).hpf(380).lpf(sine.range(3000,4500).slow(16)).gain(${gain}).room(.22).pan(sine.range(.45,.62).slow(12)).every(8, x=>x.rev()).orbit(4).play()
code.peak: note("<[db3 f3 ab3 f3 db4 ab3 f3 ab3] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3 gb4 db4 bb3 db4] [ab3 c4 eb4 c4 ab4 eb4 c4 eb4] [gb3 bb3 db4 bb3 gb4 db4 bb3 db4]>").add(note(${root})).s("wt_aguitar").attack(.003).decay(.22).sustain(.1).release(.07).hpf(400).lpf(4800).gain(${gain}).off(1/8, x=>x.add(note(12)).gain(.35)).room(.2).lastOf(8, x=>x.ply(2)).orbit(4).play()
